clips.title: The story
paras: At Silverwind Refuge, Sentinel Velene Starstrike guards central Ashenvale. She protects the sanctuary and nearby waters from rogue elementals and foul sorcerers, keeping their magic from corrupting the ancient woodland.

At Mystral Lake, Sentinel Velene Starstrike keeps watch from Silverwind Refuge. Night elf sentinels across Ashenvale work to preserve the forest's balance and defend elven sanctuaries. Silverwind Refuge offers travelers a place to rest in the central woods, and Velene helps keep the area safe.

Peace around Silverwind Refuge can be easily disturbed. Velene watches Mystral Lake, where unruly elemental spirits and reckless mage summoners upset the wilderness. She directs champions against rogue water elementals and the careless spellcasters who disturb the spirits of the land.
